Main topic of the publication.answer: This study investigates placental gene expression differences in severe preeclampsia (sPE) across African, Asian, and European ancestry groups using bulk RNA sequencing. It aims to elucidate why persons of African ancestry experience worse preeclampsia outcomes, identifying upregulation of canonical preeclampsia genes and allograft rejection/adaptive immune response genes.
